cases.input:
I keep seeing this in our runbooks and nobody can tell me how to actually use it. What is it and how do I run it?

NAME
    logsift - filter and summarize structured log files

SYNOPSIS
    logsift [-f FIELD=VALUE]... [-s FIELD] [-t START[,END]] [-n COUNT] [--json] [FILE...]

DESCRIPTION
    logsift reads newline-delimited JSON log files (or stdin when no FILE is given) and prints the entries that match every -f filter. With -s it groups matching entries by FIELD and prints a count per group instead of the raw entries.

OPTIONS
    -f FIELD=VALUE   Keep only entries where FIELD equals VALUE. May be repeated; all filters must match.
    -s FIELD         Summarize: group by FIELD and print counts, highest first.
    -t START[,END]   Restrict to a time window. Times are RFC 3339 (2026-03-02T14:00:00Z). END defaults to now.
    -n COUNT         Stop after COUNT output lines. Default is unlimited.
    --json           Emit JSON instead of the aligned text table.
    -q               Suppress the "N entries skipped (unparseable)" warning on stderr.

EXAMPLES
    logsift -f level=error /var/log/app/api.log
    logsift -f status=503 -s client_ip -t 2026-03-02T14:00:00Z,2026-03-02T15:00:00Z api.log
    cat api.log | logsift -f service=billing -n 20 --json

EXIT STATUS
    0 if at least one entry matched, 1 if none matched, 2 on usage error.

cases.input:
Explain these docs for me, I want the short version of how to use this thing.

# keyvault-sync

keyvault-sync mirrors secrets metadata (names, versions, rotation dates, never values) from one vault into a read-only inventory file so auditors can review what exists without vault access.

## Install

    npm install -g @example/keyvault-sync

## Usage

    kvsync pull --vault prod-eu --out inventory.json
    kvsync diff inventory.json inventory.old.json
    kvsync stale --max-age 90d inventory.json

`pull` authenticates with the token in KVSYNC_TOKEN (or --token-file). It writes the inventory atomically, so a failed run never leaves a half-written file.

`diff` prints names added, removed, and rotated between two inventories. Exit code is 3 when anything changed, which is handy in CI.

`stale` lists secrets whose last rotation is older than --max-age. Accepts d, w, and m suffixes (90d, 12w, 3m). Default is 180d.

## Flags (all commands)

    --vault NAME      Vault to read. Required for pull.
    --out PATH        Output file. Default: ./inventory.json
    --format json|csv Output format for diff and stale. Default: json
    --token-file PATH Read the token from a file instead of the environment
    --verbose         Log each API request (headers redacted)

## Notes

Rate limit is 60 requests per minute per token; pull backs off automatically. Vault names are case sensitive.
